notes.title: Update notes for version 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Now displays generic controller visual if connected controllers aren't recognized or fully supported
Fixed bug in which some ducks wouldn't give any points when collected
Fixed Ambient Occlusion bug on fishing rod texture
